description: SWMM by Example is a data set deposited in tdl.tdl by its authors Theodore G. Cleveland (Texas Tech University). SWMM by Example is a JupyterBook implementation of the US EPA Storm Water Management Model (SWMM). Folder was compressed using tar -cvvf filename.tar ./filename. Uncompress using tar -xvf filename.tar; Once uncompressed, the Jupyter Book build command is jupyter-book build swmmbyexample. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 601477120. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
